title: Network Share Mounter (de.fau.rrze.NetworkShareMounter)
description: Jamf Manifest for Network Share Mounter v4

networkShare.description: Example: smb://filer.your.domain.tld/share. Note: %USERNAME% will be replaced with the current user's login name.
networkShare.title: Server and share

authType.title: Authentication type
authType.description: Authentication type for the share, it can be either through Kerberos (krb) or using a username/password (pwd). Default: krb.

username.title: Username (Optional)
username.description: Optional: Predefine a username for authentication using username/password.

mountPoint.title: Mount point name (Optional)
mountPoint.description: Override the local mount point name for this share. Only applicable when the mount location is not /Volumes. Leave blank to use the share name (recommended).

options.infoText: If not set, the share name will be used.

displayName.title: Display name (Optional)
displayName.description: Optional: Display name shown for this share inside the app.

externalKerberosManagement.title: External Kerberos management (Optional)
externalKerberosManagement.description: Set to 'true' if Kerberos tickets for this share are managed by an external tool such as AD binding, Jamf Connect, or Apple SSO Extension. Network Share Mounter will mount the share without interfering with ticket management and will not show a 'profile required' warning. Only relevant for authType 'krb'.

kerberosRealm.title: Kerberos Realm override (Optional)
kerberosRealm.description: Optional: Override the Kerberos realm for this specific share. Used together with externalKerberosManagement to identify which external pseudo-profile to assign. Leave blank to use the global kerberosRealm setting.

autoMount.title: Mount automatically (Optional)
autoMount.description: Per-share flag. When set to 'false', the share is shown in the menu but is never mounted automatically at startup or on network changes. The user can still mount it manually by clicking the menu item. Default: 'true'.

disableAutoUpdateFramework.title: Disable AutoUpdater Framework
disableAutoUpdateFramework.description: Turns the auto update framework on or off, so the App can update itself.

disableDiagnostics.title: Disable Diagnostics section
disableDiagnostics.description: Hides the 'Diagnostics' section (send-diagnostics toggle, hidden log export) in Settings.

location.title: Mount path
location.description: Path where network shares will be mounted. Leave blank for the default value (highly recommended).

cleanupLocationDirectory.title: Clean up obstructing files and directories
cleanupLocationDirectory.description: If set to true, the mount location will be cleaned up from obstructing files and directories. Read the documentation before enabling this option.

autostart.title: Enable autostart
autostart.description: When deployed as a LOCKED MDM key, the value is enforced on every app launch. When deployed as an unlocked default, it is applied once on first launch only (user retains control afterwards).

canChangeAutostart.title: Allow autostart changes
canChangeAutostart.description: Controls only the visibility of the autostart toggle in the app's Settings UI — set to false to grey it out. Does NOT affect MDM enforcement. To enforce the autostart state on every launch, deploy 'autostart' as a locked key instead.

canQuit.title: Allow quit
canQuit.description: If true, the user can quit the app via the menu bar.

unmountOnExit.title: Unmount shares on exit
unmountOnExit.description: If true, managed shares are automatically unmounted when the app is quit.

kerberosRealm.title: Kerberos Realm
kerberosRealm.description: Kerberos/AD domain for user authentication (e.g. EXAMPLE.COM). Enables automatic AD/Kerberos ticket management and renewal.

kerberosProfileDisplayName.title: Kerberos profile display name (Optional)
kerberosProfileDisplayName.description: Optional display name for the Kerberos authentication profile shown in the app's Settings. If not set, the realm name (e.g. EXAMPLE.COM) is used. Useful when a friendly name like 'Corporate Network' is preferred over the technical realm string.

usernameOverride.title: Username override
usernameOverride.description: Overrides the %USERNAME% variable used in share paths. Useful when the local macOS username differs from the AD/network username.

helpURL.title: Help URL
helpURL.description: URL to your organisation's internal helpdesk or IT documentation. Shown as a link in the app.

showMountsInMenu.title: Show network mounts in menu
showMountsInMenu.description: If true, mounted and unmounted shares are listed directly in the menu bar for quick access.

ExpirationCountdownStartDay.title: Password expiration: countdown start (days)
ExpirationCountdownStartDay.description: Passive warning. Number of days before password expiry when a silent countdown item first appears in the menu bar. The user only sees this when they open the menu — no interruption. Set to 0 to disable all password expiration features. Mirrors the Apple Kerberos SSO Extension key of the same name.

ExpirationNotificationStartDay.title: Password expiration: notification start (days)
ExpirationNotificationStartDay.description: Active warning. Number of days before password expiry when an intrusive warning dialog is shown once per calendar day. Set this lower than ExpirationCountdownStartDay so the dialog only interrupts the user when expiry is genuinely imminent. Mirrors the Jamf Connect / Apple Kerberos SSO Extension key of the same name.

passwordChangeURL.title: Password change URL
passwordChangeURL.description: URL of a web-based password self-service portal (SSPR). If set, a 'Change Password' button appears in the expiration dialog and opens this URL in the default browser. If not set, the user can change their password directly within the app (requires a configured kerberosRealm).

allowPasswordChange.title: Show permanent 'Change Password' menu item
allowPasswordChange.description: If true, a permanent 'Change Password…' item is shown in the menu bar at all times, even before the expiration threshold is reached. Automatically transforms into the standard expiry countdown when the threshold is reached.

SUEnableAutomaticChecks.title: Enable automatic update checks (Sparkle)
SUEnableAutomaticChecks.description: If enableAutoUpdater is true, this controls whether the app actively checks for new versions. Set to false to suppress update checks while keeping the framework loaded.

SUAutomaticallyUpdate.title: Install updates automatically (Sparkle)
SUAutomaticallyUpdate.description: If true, updates are downloaded and installed automatically without asking the user for confirmation.

menuAbout.title: Menu: About
menuAbout.description: Show, hide, or disable the 'About' menu item.

menuConnectShares.title: Menu: Connect shares
menuConnectShares.description: Show, hide, or disable the 'Connect shares' menu item.

menuDisconnectShares.title: Menu: Disconnect shares
menuDisconnectShares.description: Show, hide, or disable the 'Disconnect shares' menu item.

menuCheckUpdates.title: Menu: Check for updates
menuCheckUpdates.description: Show, hide, or disable the 'Check for updates' menu item.

menuShowSharesMountDir.title: Menu: Show shares mount directory
menuShowSharesMountDir.description: Show, hide, or disable the 'Show shares mount directory' menu item.

menuShowShares.title: Menu: Show shares
menuShowShares.description: Show, hide, or disable the individual share items in the menu.

menuSettings.title: Menu: Settings
menuSettings.description: Show, hide, or disable the 'Settings' menu item.

menuQuit.title: Menu: Quit
menuQuit.description: Show, hide, or disable the 'Quit Network Share Mounter' menu item.

networkShares.title: Network shares (Deprecated)
networkShares.description: ⚠️ Deprecated since version 3. Use managedNetworkShares instead. This key will be removed in a future version.

enableAutoUpdater.title: Enable auto-updater framework (Deprecated)
enableAutoUpdater.description: ⚠️ Deprecated since NSM 4. Use disableAutoUpdateFramework instead (inverted logic: enableAutoUpdater=true equals disableAutoUpdateFramework=false).
